text:
Samir: Heads-up — preflight eval on v2.3.4-rc3 failed for the summarizer prompt set (delta: -12% ROUGE-L). Deploy-bot auto-triggered a hold. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/2145 :warning:

deploy-bot: PREDEPLOY CHECK FAILED
model: v2.3.4-rc3
failed_prompt_sets: summarizer-suite (regression +12%), clarification-suite (noise +4%)
actions: canary hold; suggested options: pin canary -> v2.3.3, run bisect to find culprit, or full rollback
suggested_cmds:
  `/deploy pin model=v2.3.3 scope=canary reason="preflight regression: summarizer-suite"`
  `/deploy bisect --suite summarizer-suite --from v2.3.3 --to v2.3.4-rc3`

Alyssa: I'm on call — what's our decision? Reminder: change window today 16:00-17:00 UTC. :eyes:

Marie: My read: pin canary only, start bisect to localize regression, then prepare a hotfix branch (2.3.5). Bisect should take ~30m. If it points to a model weight or tokenizer change, prefer hotfix/patch over full rollback unless risk is high.

qa-bot: QA smoke run kicked off: https://ci.internal/runs/9988 — initial checks show higher hallucination on long-context summarizer cases, and slight BLEU/Rouge drop on edge cases.

DevOps: If we pin, I'll update routing and capacity, and tag the route so we can identify metrics: tag=canary_pin_2136789012. Recommend traffic split 90/10 until we have green metrics for 30m.

Samir: Decision: pin canary to v2.3.3 now. Do NOT rollback the entire fleet. Alyssa -> start bisect and coordinate with Marie on hotfix. DevOps -> execute the pin and push a release-note stub to the tracker. I'll open a tracking ticket.

deploy-bot: COMMAND RECEIVED: `/deploy pin model=v2.3.3 scope=canary reason="preflight regression: summarizer-suite"`
deploy-bot: RESULT: queued for orchestration; expected completion ts 2136789140

Alyssa: Bisect started (summarizer-suite). I'll post results in-thread when done. :hammer:

Marie: Hotfix ticket created: https://tracker.internal/INFR-789 — assigned to infra-ml, added rollback playbook and rollback criteria, ETA for patch branch 2h depending on bisect.

DevOps: Pin applied. Routing updated. Canary now pinned to v2.3.3 (90% traffic -> v2.3.3, 10% -> rc3). Metrics watch window 30m started. :white_check_mark:

Samir: Logged decision in release tracker and added context to release notes. Notifying Product & CS. If bisect shows an obvious culprit, we will either patch or rollback that change.

Alyssa: Update — bisect results point at tokenizer preproc change in CL 4521 (diff: https://coderepo.internal/changes/4521). Dropping a short summary to the ticket.

Samir: Thanks. If tokenizer change is confirmed root cause, plan: either revert CL 4521 or ship a small fix to preserve behavior. Keep canary pinned until hotfix lands.

Marie: Agreed. Hotfix workflow started. I'll assign code owner and schedule a short review.

DevOps: Continuing to monitor. Will escalate to incident channel if errors or latency regress > 5%.

Samir: Closing out thread for now — canary frozen, bisect underway, hotfix ticket INFR-789 created. Will reopen if metrics worsen or bisect changes the plan.
